LESSON: STORYTELLING AND ANIMATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.7: Storytelling and Animation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Storytelling and Animation
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can storytelling be made interesting?
